scope: Pure engine plus installed SDK against intercepted read-only responses; no hosted writes. Node CPU timings exclude network/React.

results.name: normalization reuses categories, ranges, custom total budget and hours without inventing GPS
multiple interests and multi-category records materially affect ranking
fixed denominator penalizes missing evidence; coverage is separate from match quality
unknown admission is never free; strict total budget cannot be proved from admission
time uses visit estimates, excludes known impossible minima and preserves unknowns
geodesic distances are approximate straight-line km; missing location is safe
published-only eligibility rejects drafts, demos, deleted/inactive and malformed records
strict unknowns require explicit relaxation; verified failures remain blocked
explanations are evidence based: no budget, transport, opening or family safety claims
deterministic ranking and controlled diversity preserve strong preferences
public recommendations use the shared image-qualified catalog, ordered pages and published/demo filters
